market_summary: US stocks fell for a fourth session on Nov 17: S&P 500 -1.0% to 7,340.53 (lowest close since late July), Dow -1.6% to 50,759, Nasdaq -0.7%, led by software (CRM, INTU, NOW). The 10-yr Treasury yield was 5.10% on the treasury.gov curve, down from 5.12% on Nov 16. After the close Nvidia reported Q3 FY27 revenue of $115.8B and guided Q4 to $130B; shares rose 4.8% after hours, following a 4.3% drop on Nov 12 on news of Jensen Huang's exit as CEO. On Nov 16 the US issued a rule requiring licences for advanced chips shipped to data centres in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil that serve Chinese firms, ahead of a Trump-Xi meeting at APEC on Nov 19. Brent settled near $93 and WTI near $86 after an Iranian drone strike on Bahrain (sources differ on the exact settle).

AMZN.reason: Flat session, +0.9% after hours. Forward P/E 26; AWS demand backdrop supported by Nvidia print.

AXOS.reason: Down 1.7%. Forward P/E under 9; no new news.

BABA.reason: Down 4.4% ahead of Nov 19 results; US remote-chip-access rule risk. Options imply about 5.7% move.

ENPH.reason: Fell 7.6% on the day, extending post-earnings slide after weak Q4 guide; +2.3% after hours. No turn yet.

FIGR.reason: Down 2.5%, +2.9% after hours. Forward P/E 17; no company-specific news.

GOOGL.reason: Down 1.2% then recovered 1.2% after hours. Investor in Anthropic placement; IPO this week a valuation marker.

LDI.reason: Up 1.1%; no forward earnings estimate. Speculative position, keep small.

META.reason: Down 1.2% in session, +0.7% after hours. Forward P/E 19 reasonable for capex-heavy AI build.

MRVL.reason: Up 2.3% then 5.7% after hours; custom silicon and optics ride Nvidia's 110% data centre growth.

MU.reason: Up 4.7% after hours on Nvidia beat; forward P/E 4 signals peak-cycle earnings. Memory demand intact, sizing already large.

NFLX.reason: Down 1.8%, flat after hours. Forward P/E 17; no new catalyst.

NVDA.reason: Q3 revenue +103% y/y, data centre +110%, Q4 guide $130B; up 4.8% after hours. Forward P/E 11 already prices in leadership risk.

RKT.reason: Down 3.6% as rate jitters weigh on mortgage names; +1% after hours.

TSM.reason: Fell 3.7% in session, regained 4.6% after hours on Nvidia's $130B guide. Foundry demand confirmed.

STRIPE.reason: No new round or tender reported. Mark unchanged.

OPENAI.reason: No new round or tender reported; Anthropic IPO at about $1.2T midpoint is a peer reference.

headlines: Nvidia beat: Q3 revenue $115.8B (+103%), data centre +110%, Q4 guide $130B; stock +4.8% after hours.
Chip holdings rebound after hours: MRVL +5.7%, MU +4.7%, TSM +4.6%. MRVL moved to add.
Nvidia guides gross margin to 71-72% from 74.9%, and will vet customers it finances.
Anthropic prices IPO tonight at $70-78 (Thu morning AEDT); trades as ANT Fri 1:30am AEDT.
S&P 500 down four straight sessions to a 4-month low; 10-yr at 5.10%.
Alibaba reports Thu before US open (Thu 11pm AEDT) after -4.4% on China chip rule.
